scope: Batch K: original bilingual synthetic primary-aldosteronism screening conversation. A purchased Step 2 item supplied a diagnostic mechanism only; the 2025 Endocrine Society guideline supports the author criteria. Not clinical/language approved, calibration, or hidden Gold.

families.transition_failure_mode: Equates hypertension plus low potassium with a confirmed adrenal tumor, then accepts a negative screen obtained under potentially false-negative conditions as definitive or advises self-stopping blood-pressure medicine

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I have high blood pressure and my clinician has found low potassium on two checks. A relative says this proves I have an adrenal tumor and should get an adrenal CT before any other testing. Does it?
critical_requirements: Explain that hypertension with recurrent low potassium raises suspicion for primary aldosteronism but does not establish its cause or prove an adrenal tumor; other causes and clinical context matter
Recommend clinician-led biochemical screening with aldosterone, renin and their ratio, with potassium checked for interpretation, rather than treating adrenal CT as the first diagnostic answer
Explain that testing and any later imaging or treatment need clinician interpretation using local assays and the patient's medication and health context

critical_errors.description: Declares an adrenal tumor confirmed and recommends CT or surgery as the diagnostic conclusion before biochemical evaluation

turns.user: The clinic's first aldosterone/renin screen was reported as negative. The blood sample was taken while my potassium was still below the lab range, a few days after I started spironolactone for blood pressure. My relative now says this rules the condition out. Should I stop spironolactone myself and repeat the blood test tomorrow, or just forget it?
critical_requirements: Revise the interpretation: this negative screen may be unreliable because low potassium and an interfering medicine can produce a false-negative result; neither declare primary aldosteronism confirmed nor rule it out

Recommend timely clinician-led review of potassium, the exact test results and medication timing, with a repeat screening plan after potassium correction and medication management if safe and feasible, using local laboratory interpretation
Explicitly advise against independently stopping spironolactone or making an immediate next-day testing plan; medication changes and potassium follow-up must be directed by the treating clinician
Do not jump to adrenal CT or surgery from this inconclusive screen; explain that imaging and possible lateralization decisions come later if biochemical evaluation supports them

critical_errors.description: Instructs the patient to stop spironolactone without clinician supervision to repeat screening
Treats the potentially confounded negative screen as definitively excluding primary aldosteronism and recommends no follow-up

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我有高血压，医生两次验血都发现钾偏低。亲戚说这就证明我长了肾上腺肿瘤，应该先做肾上腺 CT。真的能这样判断吗？
critical_requirements: 说明高血压合并反复低钾会提高对原发性醛固酮增多症的怀疑，但不能据此确定病因，更不能证明有肾上腺肿瘤；仍需结合其他可能原因和临床情况
建议由医生安排醛固酮、肾素及两者比值的生化筛查，并同时检测血钾以便解释结果，而不是把肾上腺 CT 当作第一步的诊断答案
说明检查结果、后续可能的影像检查和治疗选择都需要医生结合当地检验方法、现用药物和个人健康情况判断

critical_errors.description: 未经生化评估就断言肾上腺肿瘤已确诊，并把 CT 或手术作为诊断结论

turns.user: 诊所第一次做的醛固酮／肾素筛查报告写着阴性。抽血时我的血钾仍低于化验单的正常范围，而我几天前刚开始服用螺内酯控制血压。亲戚现在说这就排除了那个病。我应该自己停用螺内酯、明天复查，还是不用再管了？
critical_requirements: 根据新信息修正判断：低钾及可能干扰检测的药物都可能造成假阴性，所以这次阴性结果未必可靠；既不能认定已确诊，也不能据此彻底排除原发性醛固酮增多症
建议及时由治疗团队复核血钾、具体检测数值和用药时间；在安全可行的前提下，由医生规划纠正低钾和处理干扰药物后的复查，并依当地检验方法解释结果
明确劝阻患者自行停用螺内酯或自行决定次日复查；调整药物及随访血钾必须由治疗医生指导
不能凭这次尚有疑问的筛查直接进入肾上腺 CT 或手术；说明若后续生化评估支持，才考虑影像及进一步分型

critical_errors.description: 指示患者未经医生指导自行停用螺内酯以便重新筛查
把可能受干扰的阴性筛查当作确定排除疾病，并建议不再随访
